Front gaze height/comfortable eye contact, no no-eye-contact nonlistening judgment or forced sustained gaze. Slow gentle voice and response wait, staff acknowledgment versus person nod not proof of comprehension/specific consent. Crossed arms/legs/lean away contextual-cultural-physical variation, no personality label. Distance/hand holding may reassure or discomfort, culture not preference substitute; timing/force/frequency, explain purpose/accepted method and stop refused touch. Step-away case respects comfortable distance and explains necessary touch, no culture-based repeated approach.

Shared records: care plus medical professions share team life support, not form-filling purpose. Plan/progress/handover/meeting/direct speech purposes, oral message not complete required record; planned versus actual. Same-day prompt facility procedure, event versus entry time; state/actual help/subsequent response distinct. Person pain words, observed skin/measured values and medical-staff assessment have explicit sources, no care-worker diagnosis or invented numbers/reactions. Receiver notes/repeats/questions, handover and next checker roles shared, suitable recipient/place/privacy. All-good-only case requires actual time/state/help/reaction/unknowns and next observation/role. Individual condition/preferences/plan/facility guidance and no unconfirmed methods retained identically in all4repeated limit paragraphs.

Body position: muscle/bone/joint movement, head/neck/chest/abdomen/back/lower back/buttocks distinct; upper shoulder/arm/elbow/wrist/palm/dorsum and lower leg/knee/ankle/heel/sole. Left-right from person, not face-to-face worker inversion, sole not heel-only. Person pointed site/onset/feeling versus actual staff observation. Part label not diagnosis or transfer competence, pain/range/ability/plan assessed and relevant person informed, no independent limb pulling diagnostic test. Right hand dorsum pain case site/time/person words and separate appearance check, no causal guess.

Visual guided walking: first voice/name and desired help/method, person pace not staff-speed pulling, actual equipment/ability/route before movement. Corner/step/floor change announced before arriving, shared person-side reference for anticipation not after-turn notice only. Guiding posture example by wishes/trained method/ongoing reaction, no sudden arm grasp or unconfirmed pull. Prior pulling-then-explaining case corrected to advance information; do not continue without route/help conditions, alternatives/assistance checked. Not authorization to attempt untrained guiding.
